g.text: What the proxy port does with each request

text.tspan: Inspect: TLS with a leaf from
the inspection CA, read each request
New TLS to the real server,
Green: new work the daemon does. Grey: bytes pass unchanged. Blue: existing route lookup, reused.
An inspected CONNECT to a .localhost name also goes to the route table.
Every case writes one request log entry: method, host, path without query, status, mode (http, tunnel, inspect).
